controles.affirmation: GOUVERNANCE/REGLEMENTAIRE : Blackstone est une "controlled company" au sens du NYSE ; l'entite detenant l'unique action de preference de serie II est detenue par les associes seniors et controlee par M. Schwarzman et nomme le conseil ; l'action de serie I represente environ 37,5% des droits de vote combines ; l'actionnaire ordinaire ne vote pas la remuneration, ne peut ni nommer d'administrateurs ni deposer de resolution ; tout actionnaire detenant 20% ou plus perd son droit de vote ; pas d'obligation de proxy statement.
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2025 : "Because the Series II Preferred Stockholder holds more than 50% of the voting power for the election of directors, we are a 'controlled company'" ; "Blackstone Group Management L.L.C., an entity owned by senior managing directors of Blackstone and controlled by Mr. Schwarzman, is the sole holder of the Series II Preferred stock... the Series II Preferred Stockholder's general ability to appoint our board of directors" ; "Blackstone Partners L.L.C. ... representing approximately 37.5% of the total combined voting power" ; "we will generally not be subject to the 'say-on-pay' and 'say-on-frequency' provisions of the Dodd-Frank Act. As a result, our common stockholders do not have an opportunity to provide a non-binding vote on the compensation of our named executive officers" ; "any person that beneficially owns 20% or more of the common stock then outstanding... is unable to vote such stock" ; "we are not required to file proxy statements or information statements under Section 14 of the Exchange Act"
